main_text.head: DE DOMINIIS ET ADQ̃VISITIONI-bus rerum. TIT. XIX.41.ff.1.
main_text.p: Mnes res aut mancipi sunt †, aut nec mancipi. Mancipi {i}res sunt prædia in Italico solo, tam rustica, qualis est fun-dus: quàm vrbana, qualis domus. Item {g}iura prædiorum rusticorum: velut via, iter, actus, & aquæductus. Item serui & quadrupedes, quæ dorso collo ve domantur, velut boues, muli, equi, asini: cæteræ res nec mancipi sunt. Elephanti {h}& camelí, quanuis collo dorsòve domentur, nec mancipi sunt: quoniam bestiarum numero sunt.2.Inst.1.tollitur dif ferentia rerū mācipi &nec mācipi tit.C. de vsucap.trās formanda. Mancipium est, quicquid capi communiter ac doma-

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "perx-ger" (line-end word, likely peregrinus) at top; the note-to-text mark correspondence in the lower half is approximate, since several superscript marks (l to q, and the mark before "Elephanti") are small and hard to match. The reference line at the foot is partly illegible and the Ix/Isidor pairing is uncertain. The marginal note i breaks into the main text line "ri solet" and its placement is approximate. Heading DE DOMINIIS: the abbreviation in ADQ̃VISITIONI is uncertain. Mark h sits in a heading, so its note is attached to the heading. No Greek or Hebrew on this page. No catchword visible.
